contract: operations_json is a JSON array of 1..100 objects. Every object has op. Optional id names an entity for later target references. Existing entities use handle; handle and target are mutually exclusive. Create a missing layer first. Read cad_catalog for block/style names. Native C# supports meshes, spatial curves, 3D solids, extrude, sweep, revolve and solid Boolean operations; use these before cad_lisp. Repeat only the EXACT request with the SAME operation_id; do not change expected_revision when replaying. Read cad_operation_status after an ambiguous response. After success use returned revision for further calls. Locked layers, xref and most specialized objects are not edited through the native path. The whole native batch rolls back on any pre-commit error. Do not repeat unknown mutations automatically.

acceptance.enforcement: Default enforce=true: failed or unavailable measurements roll back the native transaction before commit. Set enforce=false only for an explicitly diagnostic check. entity_count counts live entities affected by this batch, not the whole drawing.
acceptance.task_contract: Optional task:string, bounds_size:[x,y,z], bounds_tolerance:number, type_counts:{nativeType:count}, review_views:[current/front/back/left/right/top/isometric], visual_requirements:[strings]. Numeric checks accept either expected or minimum/maximum (inclusive), plus tolerance. Assembly properties: assembly.solid_mass_kg, assembly.solid_volume_m3, assembly.centerline_length, assembly.profile_code. Bounds/counts refer to the supplied verification handles or affected batch; final task verification must include every final object. Visual requirements remain pending until actual renders are reviewed.
acceptance.verification: Use cad_verify after commit for fresh checks. Geometry acceptance does not prove visual similarity or disk save.

notes.assembly_profiles: Read cad_steel_catalog. beam/column parameters:{length,profile:exact_catalog_code}; length uses drawing units, catalog millimetres convert using DWG units. Or supply explicit width,height,web_thickness,flange_thickness, optional root_radius. Do not combine profile with explicit dimensions. Rebar points are the sharp centerline vertices, bend_radius is the centerline radius (default 2*diameter), adjacent legs must accommodate tangency. Screw-pile blade is a native volumetric 48-segment ruled solid; mass includes blade. Existing version-1 assemblies retain their geometry until assembly_update, with legacy mass limitations reported.
notes.polyline: points share WCS Z; bulges: one number per vertex; closed:boolean; width:nonnegative constant segment width
notes.polyline3d: points is 2..2000 full [x,y,z] WCS points; optional closed:boolean
notes.spline: fit_points is 3..2000 full [x,y,z] WCS points; optional degree 1..11 below point count, closed:boolean; zero fit tolerance
notes.mesh: vertices is 3..5000 full [x,y,z] WCS points; faces is 1..2000 arrays of 3 or 4 distinct zero-based vertex indices. Produces an unsmoothed native SubDMesh, not an inferred mesh from a photograph
notes.extrude: handle/target identifies an existing closed planar polyline or circle; direction:[dx,dy,dz] is a nonzero WCS extrusion vector; source profile remains
notes.sweep: handle/target identifies an existing closed profile; path_handle/path_target identifies an existing path curve; profile should start on and be oriented for the path; source entities remain
notes.revolve: handle/target identifies an existing closed planar profile; axis_start/axis_end define the WCS axis; angle_deg has magnitude at most 360; source remains
notes.solid_boolean: handle/target is the primary Solid3d, tool_handle/tool_target is the other Solid3d; operation union/subtract/intersect; keep_tool defaults false; entire result is one transaction
notes.rotate3d: handle/target identifies an entity; axis_start/axis_end define the WCS rotation axis; angle_deg is signed
notes.sphere_cone_wedge_torus: sphere center is geometric center; cone center is bottom center; wedge/torus center is bounding-box center; torus minor_radius < major_radius
notes.block: name:existing local block; scale:positive scalar or [sx,sy,sz]; attributes:{TAG:string}
notes.block_define: name:new local definition; base_point:WCS insertion base; handles:1..100 current-space top-level source entities. Source entities remain; native C# clones them into the definition
notes.layout_create: Create an empty paper-space layout with the supplied name. Add title block and viewports separately before export
notes.layout_copy: Copy a complete existing paper-space layout including sheet contents and plot settings
notes.layout_configure: Set print device, media, plot style, paper units and rotation for a named paper-space layout
notes.viewport: Place a locked paper-space model viewport on a named layout. center/width/height are paper coordinates; model_center/model_height define WCS view and scale
notes.image_attach: Attach PNG/JPEG/TIFF/BMP by absolute path. control_points has 3..20 {pixel:[x,y],world:[x,y,z]} anchors; pixel origin top-left, all WCS Z equal. Affine residual and orientation are returned. Source file remains externally referenced
notes.civil_tin_create: In Civil 3D only, create a native TIN surface from 3..5000 non-collinear WCS [x,y,z] vertices using the current template's default surface style
notes.civil_tin_add_points: In Civil 3D only, add 3..5000 WCS [x,y,z] vertices to an existing TIN surface by handle
notes.ellipse: major_axis is a nonzero WCS XY vector from the center; radius_ratio is >0 and <=1; optional start/end angles default to 0/360 degrees
notes.hatch: boundaries:[handle or earlier id], closed polylines/circles; first is outer, others are islands; pattern defaults SOLID
notes.set: Only properties supported by the entity type are accepted; text is DBText/MText/Dimension; attributed blocks move/rotate through transform tools; use attributes to change tag values
notes.cylinder: center is center of bottom face, height positive along WCS Z
notes.color_index: ACI 0..256 for entities (0 ByBlock, 256 ByLayer); layers 1..255
notes.lineweight: hundredths of mm; -1 ByLayer, -2 ByBlock, -3 default
notes.civil_alignment_create: In Civil 3D only. layer, style and label_set are existing names (site may be empty for a siteless alignment); points are 2..500 WCS [x,y] or [x,y,z] PI points joined by fixed tangent lines; Z is ignored
notes.civil_profile_create: points are [station, elevation] pairs with strictly increasing stations; layer/style/label-set handles must refer to existing Civil objects
notes.civil_network_add_pipe: start/end are WCS points of the pipe centreline (Civil 3D Pipe.StartPoint/EndPoint), not inverts: invert elevation = centreline elevation minus half the inner pipe height. family_handle/size_handle come from the network parts list
notes.text_replace: find/replace in stored text: TEXT, MTEXT (only plain runs between formatting codes change; fonts, colours, stacks and paragraphs survive), attribute values; include may add dimensions, tables and block_definitions (definitions change every reference, inserted attribute values stay). Ø, ° and ± also match %%c, %%d and %%p. Fields, formulas and locked layers are skipped and counted. Scope: handles, or scope current/model/layout(+layout)/all, optional layers patterns, match_case, whole_word, max_changes (default 500). Preview with cad_edit_preview first
notes.offset: handle/target is a line, arc, circle, 2D polyline, ellipse or spline; distance is nonzero; side_point picks the side (otherwise the sign decides). Results keep the source properties unless layer/color_index are given; id names the first result
notes.explode: Explodes one top-level entity into its parts in the same space and erases it unless keep_original. For blocks attributes_as_text (default true) turns attribute values into TEXT/MTEXT like BURST; false leaves attribute definitions (tags) like EXPLODE
notes.join: handle/target is the base, others are handles or ids of curves meeting it end to end in one plane. A line or arc base becomes a polyline; joined curves are erased; not_joined lists the rest. Fails if nothing joins
notes.array_rect: items: handles or ids in the current space; rows and columns 1..100, row_spacing/column_spacing in drawing units (negative goes down/left), optional angle_deg rotates the grid. Plain copies, not an associative array; at most 2000 copies
notes.array_polar: items, center, count (total including the original, 2..500), angle_deg total fill (default 360: evenly spaced; otherwise first and last at the ends; negative is clockwise), rotate_items default true
notes.fillet: Two lines in one WCS XY plane (handle/target and other_handle/other_target); each keeps its end farther from the corner. radius 0 makes a sharp corner; id names the arc. FILLET_TOO_LARGE when a line would vanish
notes.chamfer: Two lines as for fillet; distance along the first line, other_distance (default distance) along the second; id names the new chamfer line
notes.trim: handle/target is the curve to cut; boundaries are handles or ids; pick_point lies on the part to remove (the nearest piece is erased, the others stay with new handles). Closed curves need two crossings
notes.extend: Extends an open line, arc or 2D polyline (WCS XY) at end start or end to the nearest boundary crossing on its extension
notes.dimension_angular: center is the vertex, first/second lie on the two legs, position lies on the dimension arc; text overrides the measured angle (keep <> to show it)
notes.mleader: points: 2..20 WCS points from the arrowhead to the landing next to the text; text is MText contents; optional height, style (multileader style name) and text_style
notes.field_text: MText with a live field showing property Length, Area, ArcLength, Circumference, Perimeter, Radius or Diameter of object_handle/object_target; precision 0..8 (default 2), factor converts units (0.000001 turns mm² into m²), prefix/suffix are literal text. Fails if the object has no such property
notes.xref_attach: Attaches (or with overlay:true overlays) an existing .dwg by absolute path at position in the current space; name defaults to the file name and must be new. Cannot be previewed
notes.block_import: Copies block definitions by exact names from another .dwg (absolute path). Existing definitions are kept unless overwrite:true replaces them (their references update). Cannot be previewed
notes.layer_merge: mapping {source:target} moves every entity (and attribute) of each source layer in all layouts and, unless include_blocks:false, in block definitions (layer 0 inside blocks is never changed) to its target. create_missing creates absent targets with the source settings; purge (default true) deletes emptied source layers. Locked sources fail
notes.xdata_set: Replaces one application's XData on an entity (app is registered if needed); values are {type,value} with type string (<=255 chars, no line breaks), real, distance, scale, int16, int32, point [x,y,z] or handle; empty values remove that application's data. Under 16 KB. cad_entity_get shows xdata
notes.xrecord_set: Stores values (same {type,value} list) under key in dictionary (default CADMCP) of the entity's extension dictionary, or of the drawing's named objects dictionary without handle/target; delete:true removes the key. cad_entity_get shows extension_dictionary
notes.preview: cad_edit_preview runs the same plan in a transaction that is always rolled back and returns the result, readback, acceptance and review with plan_hash; cad_edit with preview_hash and the same plan runs exactly that plan. Previews cannot include layouts, viewports, images, external references, block import or Civil/Map operations
notes.solid_boolean_result: The result reports volume_before, tool_volume and volume_after; an operation that would leave an empty solid fails with EMPTY_SOLID_RESULT and rolls back
notes.large_batches: Batches touching more than 250 entities are not reviewed (quality unverified, REVIEW_SKIPPED); very large readback lists are shortened (entities_truncated) while acceptance still checks all of them
